_read_me: Failures main already had on 2026-09-13, when ci-check.mjs started running in CI. Each key is the FAIL or DRIFT line a check prints, path only. ci-check.mjs fails a PR that adds a failure not listed here, and fails a PR that fixes one without deleting its line. This list only ever gets shorter, and as of ranks 19 and 20 it is empty: prompt-builder's fonts are vendored and all six social entries are cleared. An empty list is the goal state, not a bug - the next failure to land here should have to argue for itself.
